name: Grilled meat
summary: The meat that sits with cơm lam. The provincial handbook grills it unseasoned, on a skewer or in a lồ ô tube, and dips it in chili salt. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The 2024 visitor handbook on the Dak Nong provincial portal and VnExpress’s handbook of 10 Sep 2023 pair grilled meat with cơm lam. The tourism portal’s Hội Xuân Liêng Nung account names unsalted grilled pork.
howToEat: The handbook says most of the meat, from livestock or poultry, is not marinated. It is skewered over coals or cooked in a lồ ô tube, then dipped in chili salt.
At Hội Xuân Liêng Nung the tourism portal names thịt lợn nướng trui, pork grilled without seasoning, beside grilled snakehead and cơm lam.
A price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
where: With cơm lam at festivals and gatherings, including Hội Xuân Liêng Nung around Gia Nghia. A stall address is Check on arrival.
